AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants 13 4.2 Homemade Sun Dryer 13 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Homemade Sun Dryer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Animal Feed: Hay and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — newton (N)

5. B — Producers

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

7. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

10. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
